artifacts.title: Proportional reuse and contribution gate
artifacts.origin: sf0.8 Issue 31; Product A ecosystem trial
artifacts.problem: Require proportional discovery and explicit reasons before new factory machinery is built.
artifacts.upstream_assessment: No compatible end-to-end lifecycle gate found; public candidate is safer than an unrequested upstream fork.
artifacts.rationale: Portable deterministic logic with two real local consumers, tests, provenance, and no product data; human publication approval is still required.

artifacts.title: Apple distribution and submission preflight contract
artifacts.origin: sf0.8 Apple distribution increment; historical Vorynce rejection
artifacts.problem: Catch placeholder identity, metadata, orientation, paywall disclosure, review-note, and archive evidence gaps before submission.
artifacts.upstream_assessment: Consumes Apple guidance; factory-specific evidence contract is not a competing Apple implementation.
artifacts.license: Foculoom internal governance and Apple documentation references
artifacts.rationale: Two product profiles consume the same evidence contract. It remains internal because release tooling exposes factory-specific review boundaries and product readiness data.

artifacts.title: Historical App Review rejection regression fixture
artifacts.origin: sf0.7 Vorynce rejection and TestFlight evidence
artifacts.problem: Prevent recurrence of missing orientation, paywall disclosure, and review-note evidence.
artifacts.upstream_assessment: No external project can carry Foculoom's historical evidence or provenance.
artifacts.rationale: The failure is reusable knowledge and a regression fixture, not a public software package; source evidence remains preserved and cleanup is unauthorized.

artifacts.title: Product A adaptive play state machine
artifacts.problem: Coordinate Product A's interaction and audio behavior.
artifacts.upstream_assessment: Not applicable; domain and privacy coupling are product-specific.
artifacts.rationale: One consumer and tight coupling to Product A interaction/audio behavior. Rule of Two blocks premature extraction.

artifacts.title: MeowCore file-backed persistence
artifacts.origin: sf0.5 Cat Whispers; preserved in sf0.8 archaeology
artifacts.problem: Provide local persistence for a SwiftUI product without SwiftData.
artifacts.upstream_assessment: Evaluate existing Swift persistence packages before extracting or competing.
artifacts.license: Unknown until source review; do not extract yet
artifacts.rationale: A proven implementation is worth mining, but there is only one demonstrated consumer and license/source review is incomplete.

artifacts.title: Pure Swift BM25 search implementation
artifacts.origin: Edglex consolidation of Find My Loophole, Law Gaps, and Legal Exception
artifacts.upstream_assessment: Prefer an established search library if a future product needs this capability.
artifacts.rationale: The historical consolidation is product/domain-specific and has no demonstrated second consumer; preserve provenance, do not create a competing package.

artifacts.title: Canonical reusable-artifact registry schema
artifacts.problem: Record provenance, consumers, disposition, safety, lifecycle, and evidence without silent omissions.
artifacts.upstream_assessment: Uses repository-local governance; no competing package is needed.
artifacts.rationale: Two validators consume the canonical registry and tests exercise schema drift and safety failures.

artifacts.title: Capability discovery before product work
artifacts.origin: Cold-agent audit failure: discovery depended on memory
artifacts.problem: Force a fresh work session to search shared, product, external, then new-build capabilities before implementation.
artifacts.upstream_assessment: Factory-specific registry and planning boundary; no external replacement adopted.
artifacts.rationale: Cold-agent evidence proves the entrypoint finds Apple preflight before allowing work; deliberate BUILD_NEW is blocked without specialization evidence.

artifacts.title: Reuse and artifact integrity validators
artifacts.problem: Make registry, provenance, safety, and evidence failures machine-detectable in local and CI workflows.
artifacts.upstream_assessment: Factory CI wiring is local policy; no external capability should replace it.
artifacts.rationale: The local validator and CI workflow are two real enforcement consumers; tests cover skipped and malformed evidence.

artifacts.title: Implementation versus authoritative issue reconciliation gate
artifacts.problem: Prevent local implementation success from being reported as DONE while required issue reconciliation is blocked.
artifacts.upstream_assessment: Factory-specific issue reconciliation and idempotency boundary.
artifacts.rationale: The completion command and preserved incident record consume the same explicit blocked state; resume retains an idempotency key.

artifacts.title: Existing shared capability overlap check
artifacts.origin: Cold-agent deliberate Apple preflight rebuild attempt
artifacts.problem: Block a new implementation when an existing shared capability matches unless specialization is justified.
artifacts.upstream_assessment: Only one real consumer so far; do not extract further.
artifacts.rationale: The detector is proven in one planning entrypoint; Rule of Two prevents promotion until another genuine workflow consumes it.

artifacts.title: Second-consumer promotion rule
artifacts.problem: Prevent speculative one-consumer abstractions from becoming shared components.
artifacts.upstream_assessment: Internal policy tied to Foculoom evidence thresholds.
artifacts.rationale: The rule is currently exercised by one validator and fixtures; it is not promoted as a generalized package.

artifacts.title: Historical portfolio reuse-mining evidence
artifacts.problem: Preserve reusable lessons, repeated reinvention, and loss-risk priorities before cleanup.
artifacts.upstream_assessment: Historical Foculoom provenance cannot be delegated to an external package.
artifacts.rationale: The artifact records evidence-backed findings and keeps 135 uncertain candidates non-disposable; it is knowledge, not a framework.
